item.title: Knife Terminal 1.3.7
item.description: Slash commands in the chat composer: a leading / lists Claude Code's commands and your skills, with arrow keys, Tab and Enter to complete. Agent questions auto-continue: a multiple-choice question left alone takes its recommended option after a delay you pick from the new footer menu (off to 30 minutes), with a live countdown while one waits. Fixes the updater reinstalling older releases over newer builds.
